create_client_openai: create an OpenAI client with a custom base URL and API token from environment variable
create_chat_completion: create a chat completion request using the OpenAI client with a model and user message
read_completion_response: read the chat completion response and extract the assistant message from choices
run_llm_inference: run LLM inference on a custom endpoint by sending a user prompt and printing the response
configure_openai_client: configure an OpenAI client to connect to a local custom endpoint with authentication
